Title: AKU's Leadership Welcomes German Delegation
NewsSummary: On October 20th, 2022 AKU hosted a trade delegation led by the German Consul General, Dr. Rüdiger Lotz to explore collaborative opportunities between AKDN and German organisations.
NewsContent:
At AKU, we regularly partner with agencies and organizations to build capacity and further accelerate our impact across the developing world. We take pride in bringing together partners around a shared purpose.

On October 20th, 2022 AKU hosted a trade delegation led by the German Consul General, Dr. Rüdiger Lotz to explore collaborative opportunities between AKDN and German organisations. Facilitating placements of AKU's School of Nursing and Midwifery (SONAM) graduates, in German institutes, to meet the rising demand for nursing staff gave way to an exciting possibility. Import of German medical technology to support AKU's commitment to housing state-of-the-art medical equipment was also part of the talks between AKU's leadership team and Dr. Lotz. Mr. Oliver Oehms, CEO, German Emirati Joint Council for Industry & Commerce was particularly interested in AKU's medical and technological supply chain. His queries were addressed by Mr. Malik Ahmed, Director Purchasing and Supply Chain Management Division, AKU. At an institutional level, initiatives taken to respond to the climate emergency were presented by Miriam Kugele who is leading the environment and sustainability mandate at AKU. The institute's commitment to becoming carbon neutral by 2030 and the strategies being implemented in line with this commitment were lauded by the delegation. The visit culminated with a tour of AKU's campus.

Expanding our partner base to include governments, missions and embassies continues to strengthen our capabilities, within and across regions and we look forward to working alongside the German Consulate to take our mission forward.
